title: 第7章 逆天片刻就踏入极境第8章 一群人保护一个废物
slug: 太古封神第1516章直接镇压
lines: 秦云来到战技阁。
“少主，你怎么来了？”
值守的四长老不由问道。
“我四处闲逛，正好路过这里，就顺便来看看了。”
秦云怕四长老担心不让自己进入战技阁，随口编了个理由。
“后天就是十宗大会了，各宗人马都会赶至洛城附近，少主你明天就不要外出了，等后天再随我们去观摩十宗大会。”
四长老劝说道。
他怕秦云又单独跑出去，万一被居心叵测之人盯上就不好了。
先前秦云不见了。
整个玄天宗都被惊动了，要不是秦云回来了的话，恐怕整个玄天宗都会派人出去四处查找了。
四长老现在只希望，秦云老实待在玄天宗，等十宗大会结束后再出去。
“四长老放心，十宗大会举办之前我都不会外出的。”
秦云连忙说道。
“那就好。”
四长老放心了。
“四长老，我闲得无聊，我想去看看战技。”
秦云说道。
“少主你想看就看吧，但是千万不要随意偷偷修炼，战技威力太大，你的修为不能支撑，会伤到你的经脉。
“四长老劝说了一句，就让秦云进入了战技阁。
战技阁有两层。
第一层只允许弟子进入，第二层唯有长老才能进入。
秦云没有限制，直接登上第二层。
这里的战技不多，只有三十二种，都是玄级战技。
战技分为黄玄地天圣和神六个品级，其中以黄级战技最低，神级战技是最顶尖的。
玄级战技放在洛城十大宗门中是非常珍贵的，一般不会随便传给弟子，只有那些对宗门有大贡献，或是潜力巨大的弟子才被允许修炼。
秦云皱眉看着第二层的战技。
各种战技皆有，就是不知道哪种战技适合自己。
“就选风凌步和霸剑斩这两种战技，其他的不用选了，都是一些垃圾。”
银发女子说道。
秦云嘴角抽动了几下。
不过想想银发女子的神秘，还有连星月都可以成为衣衫的能力，玄级战技还真无法入她的眼。
秦云取来风凌步和霸剑斩。
“前辈，这两种战技应该很强吧？”
秦云连忙问道，能被银发女子看上的战技应该不会差。
“也是垃圾，只不过相对于其他垃圾，它们是好一些的垃圾罢了。”
content_en:
Qin Yun came to the War Skills Pavilion.
"Young Master, why are you here?"
The fourth elder on duty couldn't help but ask.
"I was wandering around and happened to pass by here, so I stopped by to take a look."
Qin Yun was afraid that the fourth elder would not allow him to enter the War Skills Pavilion, so he made up a reason casually.
"The day after tomorrow is the Ten Sects Conference. People from all sects will rush to the vicinity of Luo City. Young Master, please don't go out tomorrow. You can follow us to observe the Ten Sects Conference the day after tomorrow."
The fourth elder advised.
He was afraid that if Qin Yun ran out alone again, it would be bad if he was targeted by someone with ulterior motives.
Qin Yun disappeared earlier.
The entire Xuantian Sect was alarmed. If Qin Yun hadn't come back, I'm afraid the entire Xuantian Sect would have sent people out to search everywhere.
The fourth elder now only hopes that Qin Yun will stay in the Xuantian Sect and wait until the Ten Sects Conference is over before going out.
"Fourth Elder, don't worry, I won't go out until the Ten Sects Conference is held."
Qin Yun said quickly.
"That's good."
The fourth elder was relieved.
"Fourth Elder, I am bored and want to see some combat skills."
Qin Yun said.
"Young master, you can watch it if you want, but don't practice secretly at will. The combat skills are too powerful and your cultivation level cannot support them, and it will damage your meridians.
"The Fourth Elder persuaded Qin Yun to enter the War Skills Pavilion.
The War Skills Pavilion has two floors.
Only disciples are allowed to enter the first level, and only elders can enter the second level.
Qin Yun had no restrictions and went directly to the second floor.
There are not many combat skills here, only thirty-two, all of which are Xuan-level combat skills.
Combat skills are divided into six levels: Huang Xuan, Earth, Heavenly Sage and God. Among them, Huang level combat skills are the lowest, and God level combat skills are the top.
Xuan-level combat skills are very precious among the ten major sects in Luo City. They are generally not passed on to disciples casually. Only those disciples who have made great contributions to the sect or have great potential are allowed to practice.
Qin Yun frowned and looked at the second-level combat skills.
There are all kinds of combat skills, but I just don’t know which one is suitable for me.
"Just choose Feng Lingbu and Domineering Sword Slash. There is no need to choose the others, they are all rubbish."
The silver-haired woman said.
"Garbage..."
The corners of Qin Yun's mouth twitched a few times.
However, considering the mystery of the silver-haired woman and her ability to turn the stars and moon into clothes, her mysterious level combat skills are really beyond her reach.
Qin Yun took Feng Lingbu and Ba Jian Zhan.
"Senior, these two combat skills should be very strong, right?"
Qin Yun asked quickly, his combat skills should be good enough to attract the attention of the silver-haired woman.
"They are also garbage, but compared to other garbage, they are better garbage."
